title: Leo the Lion's Quiet Roar
description: A young lion cub discovers his roar does not need to be loud to show bravery and kindness.
character_reference: a fluffy golden lion cub with a tiny tuft of orange mane and a friendly curved tail

scenes.narration: All the big lions in the pride could shake the leaves off the trees with their mighty roars. Leo tried his very best, but his voice came out as a tiny squeaky squeak.
scenes.visual: close up of a tiny golden lion cub opening his mouth wide in a fierce pose while looking adorably small and fluffy

scenes.narration: He felt so small among the loud grown-ups and worried he would never be brave enough to help his family. He walked off to sit alone by a quiet stream.
scenes.visual: sad medium shot of the little cub sitting despondently by the edge of a calm blue stream looking down at his own reflection

scenes.narration: Suddenly, a tiny blue butterfly fluttered down with a stuck wing, trapped underneath a fallen pebble. It couldn't fly away and looked very frightened.
scenes.visual: macro view of a bright blue butterfly struggling underneath a small gray stone near wet sand and grass

scenes.narration: Leo didn't need a loud roar for this. He used his softest, gentlest paw to roll the heavy pebble away so the little butterfly could finally stretch its wings.
scenes.visual: close up of the lion cub gently nudging a small stone with his paw to free a delicate blue butterfly

scenes.narration: The butterfly landed right on Leo's nose and fluttered its wings in a joyful thank-you dance. Leo gave a happy little purr that rumbled deep in his chest.
scenes.visual: cute close up of the small cub crossing his eyes happily to look at a blue butterfly resting right on the tip of his nose

scenes.narration: He realized courage isn't about how loud you shout, but how kindly you help others in need. With a warm heart, he trotted back to his family.
scenes.visual: warm lit shot of the happy lion cub walking proudly through golden tall grass with the blue butterfly flying gracefully above his head

scenes.narration: True strength always lives inside a kind and gentle heart. Follow along for more bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: peaceful sunset over a grassy savanna with warm golden light spilling across the tranquil landscape
